tokens.subtitle: Issue downstream API keys, inspect balances, and adjust them by relative amounts.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.limitGuide: Leave empty for no cumulative spend cap. Amounts use up to six decimal places.
tokens.amountGuide: Relative amount in dollars, up to six decimal places.

channel.subtitle: Configure upstream endpoints and probe them before they take traffic.
channel.name: Name
channel.modelsGuide: One model id per line. The first model is used for connectivity tests.
channel.aliasesGuide: One mapping per line as alias=canonical.

pricing.subtitle: Four-tier USD prices per 1M tokens. Values round-trip as integer micro-USD.
pricing.usdGuide: Dollars per 1M tokens, up to six decimal places.
pricing.optionalUsdGuide: Optional. Leave empty to fall back to the input price.

settings.subtitle: Runtime switches take effect on the next inbound request, without a restart.
settings.fullBody: Log full request and response bodies
settings.fullBodyGuide: When on, subsequent requests store complete bodies on the request log.
settings.maxRequestBytesGuide: Requests larger than this are rejected with 413 immediately.
settings.saveSuccess: Settings saved. Changes apply to new inbound requests immediately.

auth.adminKey: Enter the static admin key from the config file. It is stored only in this browser.

validation.uintMin: Enter a whole number of {min} or greater
validation.usd: Enter a dollar amount with up to six decimal places
validation.usdMin: Enter a dollar amount of {min} or greater
